Good afternoon all,
Thank you for signing up for our annual symposium event:Intersections 2015: Digital Conversations on
Artificial Intelligence, Sensing and Simulation.
We look forward to seeing you tomorrow, Friday, May 29th from 9 AM-5 PM at Voorhees Theater at 186 Jay
Street in Brooklyn, NY 11201. (map<
rend KoKs&h1=en>)
This event, hosted in collaboration with the NSF TUES grant's Center for Performative Design & Engineering
Technology, will consist of a series of presentations and panel discussions, aiming to instigate a conversation
from different perspectives on the areas of data visualization, sensing, simulation, and artificial intelligence.
Attached event poster
